lines: O let us look on the Profound — ringed with higher light,
dark wiped away, lovely — and harbour in your hollow.
sanskrit_cite: api paśyema gambhīrāṃ pareṇa jyotiṣābhitaḥ unmṛṣṭatamasaṃ ramyām antarbhava bhavadguhām

lines: Hail to them, yea, who dream-caught the crescent-crowned —
the Lord, the giver of unbound delight.
sanskrit_cite: namas tebhyo 'pi ye somakalākalitaśekharam nāthaṃ svapne 'pi paśyanti paramānandadāyinam

lines: Blest One — be! — the ache to brood thy shadowy being,
keen to cut rebirth's scare: whom would it not please?
sanskrit_cite: bhagavan bhava bhāvatkaṃ bhāvaṃ bhāvayituṃ ruciḥ punarbhavabhayocchedadakṣā kasmai na rocate

lines: Life-long, world-Lord, be this our charge — by grace of thee,
to bide with mind one-pointed upon thee alone.
sanskrit_cite: yāvajjīvaṃ jagannātha kartavyam idam astu naḥ tvatprasādāt tvadekāgramanaskatvena yā sthitiḥ

lines: To the body built of thousand-boughed shruti and lore — hail;
to Śambhu, the wishing-tree of endless yield.
sanskrit_cite: śākhāsahasravistīrṇavedāgamamayātmane namo 'nantaphalotpādakalpavṛkṣāya śambhave

lines: Lodging word and thought and body's works in thee, O Master —
grown into thee, twinless: might we be — O ever, O when?
sanskrit_cite: vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi viniyojya tvayi prabho tvanmayībhūya nirdvandvāḥ kaccit syāmāpi karhicit

lines: For each world's welfare, at each making and unmaking —
to self-powered might, to the Spearman: hail.
sanskrit_cite: jagatāṃ sargasaṃhāratattaddhitaniyuktiṣu ananyāpekṣasāmarthyaśālini śūline namaḥ

lines: Past strand and phase, his mark is the Temple's crown — Dhūrjaṭi's —
his very Name: what prop besides bears fruit for brooders?
sanskrit_cite: vyatītaguṇayogasya mukhyadhyeyasya dhūrjaṭeḥ nāmāpi dhyāyatāṃ dhyānaiḥ kim anyālambanaiḥ phalam

lines: Hail, hail — 'to Śiva' — mantled in chant-force they shelter;
laudable they, bent to quaff Śāmbhavī weal.
sanskrit_cite: namo namaḥ śivāyeti mantrasāmarthyam āśritāḥ ślāghyās te śāmbhavīṃ bhūtim upabhoktuṃ ya udyatāḥ

lines: What road unreached by him? What tongue unspeaking him?
What trance untaking him? What — what is he not, O Lord?
sanskrit_cite: kaḥ panthā yena na prāpyaḥ kā ca vāṅ nocyase yayā kiṃ dhyānaṃ yena na dhyeyaḥ kiṃ vā kiṃ nāsi yat prabho

lines: Honoured here, mused here, gladdened here — this very tang —
in thousand rills, Bhava, in me, of mine — O swell.
sanskrit_cite: arcito 'yam ayaṃ dhyāta eṣa toṣita ity ayam rasaḥ srotaḥsahasreṇa tvayi me bhava vardhatām

lines: Hail the home where wit-lords garland — the Master, the Pillar,
thine, snake-threaded across the breast.
sanskrit_cite: namo niḥśeṣadhīpatrimālālayamayātmane nāthāya sthāṇave tubhyaṃ nāgayajñopavītine

lines: One drug for the gloom of unknowing — thy recall.
Bhava, for its bestowal — favour me with favour.
sanskrit_cite: ajñānatimirasyaikam auṣadhaṃ saṃsmṛtis tava bhava tattatpradānena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi

lines: Hail Īśa, who speeds each human aim to harvest;
bow-worthy — yea, the very bow — whose, here, of the steady?
sanskrit_cite: nama īśāya niḥśeṣapuruṣārthaprasādhakaḥ praṇantavyaḥ praṇāmo 'pi yadīya iha dhīmatām

lines: Sunk in the dread mere where woe-fish school —
clutching Śarva's gem, what left unmastered?
sanskrit_cite: magnair bhīme bhavāmbhodhau nilaye duḥkhayādasām bhakticintāmaṇiṃ śārvaṃ tataḥ prāpya na kiṃ jitam

lines: Uncurtained, untwinned, unshaken in wit-wealth — knowable thou art, forsooth —
yet who be these that know thee, Matted-Crown?
sanskrit_cite: nirāvaraṇanirdvandvaniścalajñānasampadām jñeyo 'si kila ke 'py ete ye tvāṃ jānanti dhūrjaṭe

lines: Stringless, yet the string-wise know thee — sole, triumphant, birth-free;
wantless, yet by kind the top prize of all wants.
sanskrit_cite: nirguṇo 'pi guṇajñānāṃ jñeya eko jayaty ajaḥ niṣkāmo 'pi prakṛtyā yaḥ kāmanānāṃ paraṃ phalam

lines: For gem and sweet immortal prize, what gods unstrained?
That milk-sea lordship — thine alone, inborn, O Bounteous.
sanskrit_cite: śrīratnāmṛtalābhāya kliṣṭaṃ yatra na kaiḥ suraiḥ tat kṣīrodadam aiśvaryaṃ tavaiva sahajaṃ vibho

lines: Hail — by love, for men's release, he blooms: Bhava, thine,
O Keeper — sung and lauded, they yield to Śambhu: joy in life, in lifelessness.
sanskrit_cite: namo bhaktyā nṛṇāṃ muktyai bhavate bhava te 'vate smṛtyā nutyā ca dadate śambhave śaṃ bhave 'bhave

lines: All-wise, all-working, all thou art — say the knowers:
what to ken, what to do, lord — for the endless, offered by thee?
sanskrit_cite: sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛt sarvam asīti jñānaśālinām vedyaṃ kiṃ karma vā nātha nānantyāya tvayārpyate
